name: Earthmother's Protection cuts Hand of the Earthmother's Rage cost by a genuine 50 percent
contract: Earthmother's Protection's tooltip: the Rage cost of Hand of the Earthmother is reduced by $s1%. Its raw effect is a flat -50 SpellMod on the wrong op and the wrong classmask (Rock Barrier's own, not Hand of the Earthmother's), so it never touched the cost at all. Fixed, it is a genuine -50% multiplicative cost modifier.

steps.label: Baseline Rage cost before the talent
The talent cuts the cost by exactly half, not a flat -50
